schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE PRODUCT (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    PRODUCT_NAME VARCHAR(255),
    UNIT_PRICE INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (UNIT_PRICE > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE SALES (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    SELLER_ID INT,
    BUYER_ID INT,
    SALE_DATE DATE,
    QUANTITY INT,
    PRICE INT,
    FOREIGN KEY (PRODUCT_ID) REFERENCES PRODUCT(PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (QUANTITY > 0),
    CHECK (PRICE > 0)
);
q1: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2: SELECT DISTINCT P.PRODUCT_ID,PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN SALES S ON P.PRODUCT_ID=S.PRODUCT_ID WHERE S.SALE_DATE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT PP INNER JOIN SALES SS ON PP.PRODUCT_ID=SS.PRODUCT_ID WHERE SS.SALE_DATE NOT BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31' AND P.PRODUCT_ID=PP.PRODUCT_ID)
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT P.PRODUCT_ID,PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN SALES S ON P.PRODUCT_ID=S.PRODUCT_ID WHERE S.SALE_DATE BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT PP INNER JOIN SALES SS ON PP.PRODUCT_ID=SS.PRODUCT_ID WHERE SS.SALE_DATE NOT BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-03-31' AND P.PRODUCT_ID=PP.PRODUCT_ID)
explanation: Q1 returns products whose all sales occurred between 2019-01-01 and 2019-03-31 (inclusive). Q2 returns products that have at least one sale in that range AND no sales outside that range. These are not equivalent. Q1 is equivalent to Q2 if all sales of a product fall within the range. However, if a product has sales only in the range, Q1 returns it, but Q2 also returns it. But if a product has sales only outside the range, Q1 returns nothing but Q2 also returns nothing. The difference arises when a product has some sales in range and some outside the range. In that case, Q1 returns the product (if min and max are both in range), but Q2 does not. Hence, they are not equivalent.
counterexample_dsp: A product with sales both inside and outside the date range. Q1 will return it if min and max are within the range, but Q2 will not.
